records.title: LSE Excellence Scholarship
records.deadline_display: Awards will be made to candidates on a rolling basis during the application cycle, until all awards are allocated.

source.publisher: London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)
source.as_of: Postgraduate Taught students joining LSE in 2026
source.raw_extract:
LSE Excellence Scholarships are prestigious awards for exceptional Postgraduate Taught students joining LSE in 2026. These scholarships recognise applicants who demonstrate outstanding academic ability and strong potential to thrive in their chosen programme. [...] No financial support application is required for this scholarship. Awardees will be identified based on their application for admission.

Awards will be made to candidates on a rolling basis during the application cycle, until all awards are allocated.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Awards will be made to candidates on a rolling basis during the application cycle, until all awards are allocated.
source.notes: The shard's official_source_url (LSE Master's Awards page) states no deadline of its own and refers readers to the 'How to apply for a scholarship' page. The dedicated official page for this named award, linked from LSE's graduate 'Fees and funding' index, states the award process explicitly as rolling. The page publishes no calendar date, so per contract no deadline_date is written. The only dated item found on the related LSE how-to-apply page (Graduate Financial Support Application deadline of 23 April 2026) explicitly does NOT apply to this scholarship, because the scholarship page says 'No financial support application is required for this scholarship'. Confidence HIGH on the rolling wording; the 2026 cohort wording means no 2027 cycle date is published either.

https://www.lse.ac.uk/study-at-lse/Graduate/fees-and-funding - graduate fees and funding index; used to locate the dedicated LSE Excellence Scholarship page

records.title: Budapest University of Technology and Economics (BME) Scholarships

source.publisher: Budapest University of Technology and Economics (BME)
source.raw_extract: BME offers scholarships at over 350 universities across Europe and more than 20 universities outside the European Union. The same goes for professional internship opportunities—arm yourself with as much competence and knowledge as possible during your student years. We provide scholarships on an ongoing basis, even for those looking to expand their postgraduate studies.
source.notes: The official BME scholarship pages publish no application deadline for this umbrella record. 'We provide scholarships on an ongoing basis' is about the availability of awards, not an explicit statement that applications are rolling or that there is no fixed deadline, so ROLLING was not asserted; it is too vague to classify. The Education-menu BME scholarship page carries only stale, unrelated dates ('available between 17th of October till 15th of November, 2022' for an E033 institution-change request, and 'The website will open for SH transfer students on 27th March, 2023' / 'The application deadline for transfer students is 16th of April, 2023'), all expired and none describing the current application window. The Hungarian home page for Aktuális ösztöndíjak also carries no date. Named programmes on that page (Stipendium Hungaricum, Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship, Scholarship for Christian Young People, Students at Risk) route applications to Tempus Public Foundation or Hungary Helps Agency; their own deadlines were not fetched and not used, since they are third-party programme deadlines for different awards.

records.title: Tampere University tuition fee scholarship (50%) and early bird offer
records.deadline_display: To be considered for Tampere University Scholarships, you must apply for the scholarship as part of your application for admission during the application period for admission.

source.raw_extract:
### Scholarships available at admission in 2027

Tampere University offers a limited number of partial scholarships as well as an early bird discount to support fee-paying students. [...] Tampere University tuition fee scholarship is an exclusive opportunity awarded to a limited number of the best-performing applicants.

It is a highly selective scholarship, annually only individual Tampere University scholarships are awarded to exceptionally qualified applicants. [...] Students may take advantage of the early bird offer by accepting the offered study place and paying the reduced first year tuition fee within three weeks (21 days) after receiving information on admission. [...] To be considered for Tampere University Scholarships, you must apply for the scholarship as part of your application for admission during the application period for admission. You will apply for Tampere University Scholarships with the same online application you use to apply for admission at Studyinfo.fi.
source.exact_deadline_wording: To be considered for Tampere University Scholarships, you must apply for the scholarship as part of your application for admission during the application period for admission.
source.notes: The page publishes no calendar deadline. Timing is described as recurring and tied to the admission cycle: awards are made 'at admission in 2027' and 'annually only individual Tampere University scholarships are awarded'. The early bird offer window is relative, not calendar - 'within three weeks (21 days) after receiving information on admission' - so no date can be derived from it. ANNUAL/recurring therefore, and no deadline_date is written. Studyinfo.fi admission-round dates were deliberately not imported as a deadline for this record's application.
